selection_note: 25 development-half entries of this exact deck_name (all 25 with a decklist, all 20 cards, one deck id) in 20 events, Aug 26 to Sep 21, 2026. Six of the 25 carry a census card, and the only card any of them carries is 1 Protective Poncho B2 147; none carries a switch-1 card (groups 1 to 3). Ranked by placing then event size, the six carriers are: khaeruibnum 10th of 73 (Sep 11, 5-2-0) = THIS LIST; khaeruibnum 34th of 64 (THE BREAKFAST CLUB KELP CLASSIC #9, 6aa1e900a4272c53be64c5ce, Sep 10, 1-6-0; same list except 1 Mars A2 155 in place of Team Rocket's Thieving Machine); pamnardo_s2 63rd of 81 (FAREWELL B4!, 6a8b75058302ae761e5fab7e, Aug 26, 1-3-0, dropped; a different build: 1 Mega Altaria ex, Eevee/Espeon line, Lisia, Training Area, X Speed, no Leaf, no Thieving Machine); pamnardo_s2 67th of 69 (The Breakfast Club Pop Up, 6a8f27e57a62de813013fb20, Aug 26, 0-3-0, dropped; the same 20 cards as pamnardo_s2's other entry); khaeruibnum unplaced, dropped 1-3-0 at 219 players (Umbreon99's Aura Sphere #4, 6a7e2b83cdc0391d7fa65afb, Sep 11; the same 20 cards as this list); khaeruibnum unplaced, dropped 1-1-0 at 53 players (The TCGP Arena #6, 6aabc067f1243e65f98035ec, Sep 21; the same 20 cards as this list). The archetype's best placings in the window do NOT carry a census card and so were ineligible: carlos_781 5th of 118 (The Breakfast Club Nightly-$20, 6a9dc423ab080c8c957fc250, Sep 7, 8-2-0) and yunlong 6th of 116 (Tournament Vegegras, 6a78c5912b308b6067b4f421, Sep 5, 8-2-1); both run Lisia, Training Area and X Speed or Repel/Small Balloon in place of Leaf, Thieving Machine and Poncho. The chosen list is a 2-2 Swablu/Mega Altaria ex, 2 Darkrai, 2 Igglybuff build with 2 Leaf and no Stadium; it is khaeruibnum's list in three of the six carrier entries.
printings: Every card uses the exact set/number the Limitless source names (number zero-padded to three digits in the deck file). python lib/card.py reports each of the 12 ids as '1 printings, 1 distinct', so no printing choice was needed. The source's energy field is ["Psychic"]; Darkrai's attack costs Colorless only, so the single Energy type is what the source plays.
